notes.title: 1.11 Update
notes.content:
1.11 Update

Improvements

-Added a confirmation prompt when pressing the restart button to prevent accidental restarts.

Bug Fixes

-Resolved an issue causing the game to freeze under certain conditions.

notes.title: 1.09 Update
notes.content:
1.09 Update

Improvements

-New costumes.
-New achievements.
-Secret map – wait, we weren't supposed to mention that.

Bug Fixes

-Resolved the issue causing online character color changes to not function as intended.

Improvements

notes.title: 1.03 Update
notes.content:
1.03 Update
Improvements
-Enhanced the physics of Jumpers to ensure smoother and more consistent bounces.
-Balanced the Jumper area that players found extremely difficult, providing a fairer and more enjoyable challenge.
